observances.name: Sanjivan samadhi sohala (Kartiki)
observances.tithi: Samadhi tithi Trayodashi (Vishwakosh). Festival run Shashthi to Amavasya per Marathi Wikipedia; biggest day Ekadashi per en Wikipedia; Bridge Chronicle says the 2024 celebrations began on Ashtami
observances.usual_gregorian_window: Late November to early December. Only data point: Ekadashi day was Tuesday 26 Nov 2024 (the 728th anniversary). 2026: Ekadashi Friday 4 Dec; samadhi day Sunday 6 Dec (see DNYG-P-OB01 to OB06).
observances.organiser: Alandi Devasthan (per local practice; newspapers opened do not all name it)
observances.rituals: Pavamaan abhishek and dudharathi before dawn, kakda bhajan at Muktai Mandap, mahapuja, mahanaivedya, rathotsav, kirtan at Veena Mandap, nagar pradakshina with the silver mask, bath in the Indrayani (2024 programme)
observances.notes: Sources disagree on which Vadya days make up the festival; tithi of the samadhi (Trayodashi) is separate from the Ekadashi peak. Newspapers call the peak Kartiki Ekadashi, which is not the Prabodhini Ekadashi two weeks earlier. 2026 programme: the festival opens on Haibatbaba's payri pujan on 1 Dec and ends on 8 Dec, so it does not follow the Shashthi-to-Amavasya span in Marathi Wikipedia (Amavasya falls on 8 Dec per one calendar page, DNYG-P-S19). Administration preparations (Alandi municipal hall meeting, 17 Nov) aim to finish by 30 Nov; police deployment starts 1 Dec; about 1,000 mobile toilets and 180 CCTV cameras are planned (Pudhari, 18 Nov).
observances.programme_2026: Announced 16 Nov 2026 in Pudhari and eSakal: Akhand Harinam Saptah from 29 Nov (Pudhari only); sohala opens 1 Dec with the step-worship (payri pujan) of Haibatbaba at the Deulwada; Kartik Vadya Ekadashi on Friday 4 Dec (main pre-dawn puja); Dwadashi 5 Dec with the rathotsav at 4 pm; samadhi day Sunday 6 Dec (noon observance); wari concludes Tuesday 8 Dec with the night palkhi circuit of the town and the Chhabina procession.
observances.revision_note: Added the 2026 programme from Pudhari and eSakal (16 Nov 2026), checked against five calendar pages for the tithi dates. Existing 2024 text kept.

observances.name: Samadhi tithi and its date in 1296 CE
observances.usual_gregorian_window: Same festival window; the 1296 weekday is given as Sunday 2 Dec in one part of Marathi Wikipedia and as Thursday in another part

observances.name: Dnyaneshwar jayanti (birth anniversary)
observances.usual_gregorian_window: August. Observed at midnight on Monday 26 Aug 2024
observances.organiser: Alandi Devasthan (Harinam saptah and evening kirtan; the midnight kirtan was hosted by a local family)
observances.rituals: Gokul puja in the samadhi gabhara, silver mask and gold ornaments on the samadhi, Haripath after the evening dhoop aarti, midnight kirtan on the birth, showering of flowers, sweets and ginger powder prasad
observances.notes: Birth tithi follows the received biography (Marathi Wikipedia: Shravan Vadya Ashtami, Shaka 1197); birth year has variants 1271 or 1275 in the package.

observances.name: Ashadhi wari palkhi prasthan from Alandi
observances.paksha: Vadya at departure; Shukla Ekadashi at Pandharpur
observances.tithi: Departure on Jyeshtha Vadya Ashtami (2024 Lokmat); Ashadhi Ekadashi = 11th tithi of Ashadha (Shukla). 2026: no source opened states the departure tithi; none computed.
observances.usual_gregorian_window: Departure 29 Jun 2024; 19 Jun 2025; 8 Jul 2026. Ashadhi Ekadashi 17 Jul 2024; 6 Jul 2025; 25 Jul 2026. Window shifts by a month with adhik masa. 2026 dates confirmed by many outlets (see palkhi_stages).
observances.organiser: Alandi Devasthan with the palkhi sohala head and committee; district and police administrations along the route
observances.rituals: Prasthan from the samadhi temple (3 pm in four sources, 4 pm in three), halts at Pune and Saswad, ringan stages, meeting with Sopandev palkhi at Bhandishegaon, arrival and Ekadashi at Pandharpur, return, concluding nagar pradakshina at Alandi
observances.notes: Tithi for 2026 not stated by 2026 sources; the 2024 tithi is given by Lokmat (S16) only. 2026 had a later start than 2024 and 2025. A page giving 29 June as the 2026 departure is a 2024 page and is recorded as a withdrawn variant (DNYG-P-PS04).
observances.revision_note: Departure time variant and withdrawn 29 June variant noted; dates confirmed in palkhi_stages.

observances.name: Kartiki Ekadashi crowd at Alandi
observances.rituals: Indrayani bath, nagar pradakshina with the silver mask, first darshan at the early puja
observances.notes: About five lakh visitors reported in 2024.
observances.revision_note: Added the 2026 Ekadashi date (Friday 4 December), confirmed by two newspapers and four calendar pages.

observances.name: Kartik Vadya Ekadashi 2026 at Alandi (Kartiki yatra peak)
observances.tithi: Ekadashi of the waning fortnight of Kartik (amanta; Margashirsha Krishna in the north-Indian count). Tithi runs 11:04 PM 3 Dec to 11:45 PM 4 Dec (New Delhi, PanchangBodh); Hyderabad panchang ends it 11:44 PM on 4 Dec
observances.organiser: Alandi Devasthan (not named in the two newspapers; the chief trustee performs the samadhi-day puja per Pudhari)
observances.rituals: Pre-dawn main puja at the samadhi by 12 Brahmavrinda with Vedic chanting; temple open for darshan all day; the palkhi leaves Deulwada at 1 pm for a town circuit and returns about 9 pm (Pudhari)

observances.name: Sanjeevan Samadhi day 2026 (Kartik Vadya Trayodashi)
observances.tithi: Trayodashi of the waning fortnight; Krishna Trayodashi runs from about 12:51 AM on 6 Dec to 2:22 AM on 7 Dec (New Delhi, Drik Panchang); Ravi Pradosh Vrat that day
observances.organiser: Alandi Devasthan (not named in the two newspapers; the chief trustee performs the samadhi-day puja per Pudhari)
observances.rituals: Pavamaan abhishek and milk aarti by the chief trustee 3-4 am; devotees' puja on the chal paduka 5-9:30 am; kirtans at the Mahadwar (7-9 am) and Veena Mandap; a kirtan on the samadhi episode by Namdev's descendants 9 am to noon; the samadhi observance at noon (Pudhari). Both newspapers give 6 Dec as the samadhi day; neither uses the word Trayodashi, which comes from the calendar pages.

observances.name: Sohala opening 2026: Haibatbaba step-worship
observances.tithi: Not stated (about Kartik Vadya Ashtami by count; not computed)
observances.organiser: Alandi Devasthan (not named in the two newspapers; the chief trustee performs the samadhi-day puja per Pudhari)
observances.rituals: Opening ceremony of the wari: payri pujan of Guru Haibatbaba at the Deulwada, Alandi (Pudhari, eSakal). Pudhari adds that an Akhand Harinam Saptah begins on 29 Nov (single source).

observances.name: Wari conclusion 2026: night palkhi circuit and Chhabina procession
observances.tithi: Not stated; Amavasya per one calendar page
observances.organiser: Alandi Devasthan (not named in the two newspapers; the chief trustee performs the samadhi-day puja per Pudhari)
observances.rituals: Night palkhi circuit of the town and the Chhabina procession mark the end of the Kartiki wari (Pudhari); eSakal gives the end date 8 Dec in its headline only.

observances.name: Dwadashi 2026: government puja and rathotsav
observances.organiser: Alandi Devasthan (not named in the two newspapers; the chief trustee performs the samadhi-day puja per Pudhari)
observances.rituals: Government puja about 3:30 am with the Prant Officer present; palkhi leaves Deulwada at 4 pm for the traditional rathotsav (Pudhari only).

observances.name: Akhand Harinam Saptah 2026 (start)
observances.organiser: Alandi Devasthan (not named in the two newspapers; the chief trustee performs the samadhi-day puja per Pudhari)
observances.rituals: Continuous Harinam chanting week begins 29 Nov (Pudhari only). Whether it ends on the samadhi day is not stated.

palkhi_stages.palkhi_name: Sant Dnyaneshwar Maharaj palkhi (Alandi to Pandharpur and back)
palkhi_stages.uncertainty: Free Press: leaves Pune for Alandi on 8 Aug; Punekar: arrives at Alandi on 8 Aug. These can be one journey (leave in the morning, arrive the same day), so they are not necessarily in conflict; neither source gives a time. Both agree that 9 August is at Alandi. The first round recorded this as a conflict; the reading 'leaves Pune and arrives at Alandi on 8 August' is compatible with both.

palkhi_stages.tithi: Not stated for 2026 by any source opened (the 2024 tithi, Jyeshtha Vadya Ashtami, is from a 2024 Lokmat page). Not computed.
palkhi_stages.halt_type: night halt at Alandi, Gandhiwada darshan-bari mandap (palkhi ancestral house)
palkhi_stages.rituals: Prasthan from the samadhi temple on 8 July; the first night is spent inside Alandi. Departure time is a variant: about 3 pm in four sources (Lokmat Times, Free Press Journal, Punekar News and a Free Press piece of April about the Pune halt), 4 pm in three (Zee 24 Taas, Pudhari, tirthayatra). The 4 pm reports are the later ones (4 July onward); no source says the time was changed.
palkhi_stages.dindi_count: 56 traditional dindis with 10 warkaris each at the prasthan ceremony (1,660 people in all); single source, a ceremony reduced because the Indrayani was in flood
palkhi_stages.uncertainty: Sources list one place per date; only the first night is stated to be inside Alandi. Departure time disputed (3 pm vs 4 pm).
palkhi_stages.revision_note: 9 outlet(s) agree on date and halt for this row (confirmed). Night halt and the 3 pm / 4 pm variant added from Zee 24 Taas Marathi and Pudhari; day-of reports (webindia123 wire page, Zee) corroborate 8 July.

palkhi_stages.palkhi_name: Sant Dnyaneshwar Maharaj palkhi (Alandi to Pandharpur and back)
palkhi_stages.halt_type: night halt (Pudhari: overnight halt in Pune on 9 July)
palkhi_stages.rituals: Halt at the Palkhi Vithoba Temple (police note S25)
palkhi_stages.uncertainty: Free Press (9 July) says the Dnyaneshwar palkhi entered Pune on 9 July and halted at the Palkhi Vitthal Temple, Bhavani Peth. An April Free Press piece reports a proposal to move the halt (SP College ground was named as a possible alternative) and a ten-crore improvement plan; the 9 July report shows the Bhavani Peth halt was kept.
palkhi_stages.revision_note: 8 outlet(s) agree on date and halt for this row (confirmed). Distance added from hindupad only. Date and halt corroborated by a day-of report (Free Press Journal 9 July) and by the PMPML bus article.
palkhi_stages.distance_note: hindupad route section (DNYP-S14, Q4): one source, not tied to 2026 on the page (it mixes years), figures printed with odd two-digit endings (for example 26.04); the Lonand-Taradgaon leg is printed as both 9.80 and 9.080. Natepute-Malshiras-Velapur is printed as one 16.06 km leg, so the two stages 13 and 14 carry no figure.
palkhi_stages.tukaram_palkhi_note: The Tukaram palkhi also entered Pune on 9 July 2026 and halted at the Nivdung Vitthal Temple, Nana Peth (Free Press Journal 9 Jul; Punekar News Tukaram page). Both palkhis halt in Pune 9-10 July; no source describes a meeting between them.

palkhi_stages.palkhi_name: Sant Dnyaneshwar Maharaj palkhi (Alandi to Pandharpur and back)

palkhi_stages.revision_note: 6 outlet(s) agree on date and halt for this row (confirmed). Two-night Pune halt (9 and 10 July) is the reading of every source that lists both dates.
